question_or_proposition: For Outfall 001 during Federal FY2025, do the discharge limitations and monitoring requirements tied to this authorization clause apply only when one or more of the four enumerated authorized discharge types (storm runoff from storage and production areas, once-through cooling water, cleaning water, and Artesian well water) is occurring, or do they apply to any discharge from Outfall 001 throughout the authorization period without discharge-type conditioning?
required_context: The nominated authorization clause for Outfall 001 in Part I Section A
The immediately following sentence linking 'Such discharges' to the Outfall 001 limitations and monitoring table
Federal FY2025 monitoring periods and any evidence of which discharge types were occurring at Outfall 001
notes: The clause authorizes specific discharge types for a bounded period and introduces the Outfall 001 limits and monitoring table. How the enumerated discharge types relate to downstream limit and monitoring applicability could change which measurements receive numeric limit comparisons, whether monitoring was required, and how missing or no-result evidence should be classified.
